notes: PlaybackStore phases A and B -- the store now DECLARES what is playing instead of inferring it from polling. A declaration carries the URI it was made against, so a resolved name or artwork displays only while that URI is what Sonos currently reports; stale text can no longer travel with its own URI and corroborate itself past the freshness check, which is what made the round-trip transfer bug so durable. Phase B made the store own LAST PLAYING: it never expires and persists to zone_last_playing (schema v20), restored for every zone at launch, so an idle zone shows what it last played rather than nothing. Station identity moved to per-service adapters (fRadioServiceAdapters) -- iHeart identifies by station code, SomaFM by channel slug -- so adding a service is a new file rather than another exception in shared matching logic. Fixed along the way: AIFF duration (the sample rate was read at the sampleSize offset, so the exponent underflowed to zero and duration was silently skipped); local playback that loaded a track with full metadata but never started (wedged transport, fixed with Stop before SetAVTransportURI plus post-play verification); idle and playing zones resolving stations through separate implementations that disagreed, so two zones on the same stream showed different names; and a failed station lookup being cached forever, which stranded a zone until the app was force-quit. Remaining: phases C (group/ungroup), D (demote polling to transport-only), E (retire the replaced side-channels), then ZoneDiscoveryService decomposition.
